description: A Drupal form class for managing system branding off-canvas settings, including site name and slogan, with dependency injection and form handling methods.

classes.name: SystemBrandingOffCanvasForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for system branding off-canvas configuration, extending PluginFormBase and implementing ContainerInjectionInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting configuration factory and current user services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the form for site branding settings, including site name and slogan.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Saves site name and slogan if allowed, then delegates submission handling to the plugin.
